plan.notes: University of Denver is on the quarter system (Fall/Winter/Spring); term_system=quarter. Official sample 4-year course plan from the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Bulletin Accounting program PDF (12 quarters). Degree requires 186 credits (Bachelor of Science in Accounting, BSAcc); plan totals 186. Generic slots (business courses per footnotes 3/5/7, language/SI sequences, Common Curriculum, electives, study-abroad block) encoded as choice slots exactly as the official plan lists them; no courses invented. ITEC 3155 appears in the plan without a stated title; code retained, title not invented. INTZ 2501 required only for students who study abroad (footnote 6).
